_comment: Region dimensions are in TILES, and one tile is roughly one metre — dungeon corridors are a
tile wide and the hero's radius is 0.35. Sizes are derived from Starting Region.md's geography
rather than picked: a 60-tile mountain mass you can actually tunnel into, a walled town core,
the spec's ~100m cleared band on every open side (200 tiles per axis), and the forest fringe.
Owner rulings 2026-08-06: keep 1m tiles and let regions be genuinely large (#35); the mine is
dug out of the mountain rather than pressed as a button, so the mountain needs real depth.
regionWidth/regionHeight/population/forestDepth feed the region generator; the hostility
